title: 浮层
summary: 浮在页面上只是外观。先定打不打断当前任务，以及是否贴着触发点。
summaryEn: Floating is only the look. First decide whether it interrupts the current task, and whether it sticks to the trigger.
asks: 这块浮层打不打断、贴不贴触发点？
asksEn: Does this overlay interrupt, and does it stick to the trigger?

links.when: 若它是往下展开且提交一个值

links.when: 右侧抽屉不是隐藏式侧栏
